item.title: Release Notes
item.description: 0.28.0 (2025-10-01) Upgraded to JDK 21 Implemented multi-arch builds for container images Added run persistence monitoring to track benchmark progress Introduced a setting for SSL handshake timeout Added a useHttpCache option in the benchmark JSON schema Allowed the use of local benchmarks for testing purposes Reduced GC pressure and improved efficiency when parsing HTTP headers Implemented allocation-free date parsing to lower memory usage Optimized Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding header matching Added custom wait logic to avoid CPU spinning and reduce idle CPU usage Stopped using a session if its scheduled delay has already expired Fixed an issue where the JsonParser would fail with fragmented responses The deprecated run-local command has been removed Updated major dependencies, including Vert.
